details:
**Q1: Which area of this repository should be improved?**
Choices:
- **A** — GitHub Actions workflows under `.github/workflows/` (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Shell/Python support scripts under `scripts/`
- **C** — Documentation only (`README.md`, `agents.md`, docs)
- **D** — A specific file or feature you will name
Reply: `Q1: A`
**Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?**
Choices:
- **A** — Fix a bug or broken behavior you observed (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Add a small new feature
- **C** — Improve reliability/performance without changing intended behavior
- **D** — Clean up wording/docs only
Reply: `Q2: A`
**Q3: How should the target be identified?**
Choices:
- **A** — I will provide the exact file path(s) or workflow/script name(s) (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — I will describe the specific behavior/symptom to trace
- **C** — I want you to pick one area yourself
Reply: `Q3: A`
